name: key_for_completion / key_for_s1 / key_for_embedding

test_list.description: Identical inputs derive the identical 32-byte key.
A different sampling-params digest gives a different key.
The same inputs in Global, two Workspace scopes and a Session scope give four different keys (isolated storage level).
A different stable-prefix Cid gives a different key.
S1, S2 and embedding keys over the same bytes never coincide (domain separation).
model "ab" + tail "c" and model "a" + tail "bc" give different keys.
Distinct S1 inputs never share a key (blake3, never xxh3 — safety decisions cannot be poisoned by crafted collisions).

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.type: model, params digest, prefix Cid, tail / schema digest, input
inputs.description: Everything that determines the cached value.

output_description: Scope, kind and a domain-separated, length-prefixed blake3 digest.
